hero.subtitle: Australian government and corporate bonds across the capital structure, actively managed to earn higher income through the rate cycle.

about.title: About the Fund
about.body: The Fund draws on the widest toolkit in the Arculus range: government and semi-government bonds, investment grade corporate senior and subordinated debt, ASX-listed hybrids and cash, with up to 30% permitted below investment grade. The discipline is structural: no leverage, no structured credit, no foreign currency. Net asset value was $108 million as at 31 January 2026.

whoItMaySuit.title: Who it may suit
whoItMaySuit.body: Investors seeking higher income than cash and traditional debt provide, with medium risk over a three to five-year horizon — a regular income draw, or the return-seeking sleeve of a fixed income allocation alongside a defensive core.

howManaged.title: How the Fund is managed
body: Government bonds provide ballast; investment grade senior and subordinated debt carries the income; a measured allocation to hybrids and higher-yielding paper adds return where it is paid for. Positioning follows the team’s reading of the rate cycle and credit margins — never an index weight.
Allocations below investment grade sit inside a hard mandate cap, and every decision passes four-eyes governance before it settles, with operational oversight independent of the investment desk.
